test_description: Retrospective out-of-time; some July-September 2026 data informed earlier project research. Not pristine holdout.
intrabar_order: Barrier-crossed bar open establishes precedence; otherwise double-touch bars remain ambiguous.
selection_rule: No automatic winner selection, tuning, model fitting or promotion in this descriptive screen.
uncertainty: Descriptive 95% five-session moving-block bootstrap on observable outcomes; ambiguous labels additionally receive pessimistic/optimistic bounds. Not simultaneous or multiple-testing-adjusted confidence.
confirmation_requirement: Freeze at most one candidate and its baseline after development/validation; predeclare primary contrasts, effect sizes and Holm family before confirmatory analysis. Do not select on historical test cells. Require prospective confirmation after freeze plus separate net execution and option replay.
daily_results: No forced daily entry. Report eligible, no-event, missing and ambiguous observations separately.
not_implemented_in_v1: Trade entries/fills/exits, costs, options P&L or profitability
RVOL, historical OI, macro-event or cross-asset filters
Predictive model calibration or multiplicity-adjusted hypothesis tests
